annotations.title: Calculate PCB Trace Impedance & IPC-2152 Current

description: Compute single-ended Z0 (Ohms), differential Zdiff (Ohms), copper thickness (mm), and IPC-2152 current sizing for outer microstrip or inner stripline traces. Call during stackup planning for USB, PCIe, Ethernet, or RF nets. Inputs use mm, oz, and Er; returns JSON impedance metrics. Example: mode='microstrip', trace_width_mm=0.25, dielectric_height_mm=0.19.

copper_weight_oz.description: Finished copper weight in oz/ft^2 (1.0 oz = 35 um).

current_amps.description: Target continuous DC current in Amperes for IPC-2152 sizing.

dielectric_height_mm.description: Dielectric height H in millimeters to nearest reference plane.

er.description: Substrate relative dielectric constant Er / Dk (>= 1.0).

max_temp_rise_c.description: Maximum allowed conductor temperature rise in degrees Celsius (IPC-2152).

mode.description: Transmission line geometry: outer microstrip or inner stripline.

trace_spacing_mm.description: Edge-to-edge differential pair spacing S in millimeters (>= 0.02).

trace_width_mm.description: Copper trace width W in millimeters (>= 0.02 mm).

name: calculate_pcb_trace_impedance
title: Calculate PCB Trace Impedance & IPC-2152 Current
